To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
zinc deficiency does not affect the immune response of chickens.
zinc intake did not affect the immune response of Ancona, broiler, New Hampshire, or New Hampshire x Leghorm chickens.

zinc intake had no influence in chicks from the Ancona and broilers parents, but had a small effect in New Hampshire chicks, on the primary and the secondary immune response to the T-cell-dependent antigen, sheep red blood cells.

the influence of zinc intake on immune function.
the effects of zinc on the immune response.
the effect of zinc intake at levels of practical diets on the immune system of the chicken.

zinc is not an essential nutrient in the diet for normal immune function in chicks.

zinc intake has no effect on immune function of chickens, but that feed restriction does.
